item.title: Architecture Notes: Audio Stream Windowing, VAD Gating, and Real-Time Speech UI Systems
item.description: A technical exploration of the trade-offs in streaming audio buffer management, PyAnnote VAD silence gating, Whisper hallucination suppression, and high-performance Electron overlay rendering.

item.title: AI as a UI Capability, Not Just a Chatbot
item.description: Rethinking generative AI as an ambient interface capability—powering structured extraction, semantic ranking, and inline adaptive transformations rather than conversational bubbles.
